1: -module(quod_quic_SUITE).
    2: -moduledoc """
    3: Integration test for the QUIC transport over a real loopback connection: a node
    4: opens a link to itself, and a framed payload is pushed across a real QUIC stream
    5: and observed via the gproc `{channel, _}` property as `{quod_message, ...}`.
    6: """.
    7: 
    8: -include_lib("common_test/include/ct.hrl").
    9: 
   10: -export([all/0, init_per_suite/1, end_per_suite/1]).
   11: -export([open_link_succeeds/1, message_roundtrip/1, bidirectional_reuse/1,
   12:          stream_priorities_survive_reopen/1, priority_mixed_traffic/1,
   13:          tagged_catchup_open_preserves_pools/1,
   14:          channel_stream_reset_isolated/1,
   15:          ordered_send_waits_for_send_ready_fifo/1,
   16:          connection_death_resolves_pending_waiters/1,
   17:          inbound_channel_reset_is_scoped/1,
   18:          explicit_link_retires_with_last_owner/1,
   19:          pinned_leases_share_link_until_last_release/1,
   20:          pinned_lease_release_is_connection_exact/1,
   21:          late_released_link_cannot_consume_replacement_waiter/1,
   22:          non_dialable_node_id/1, unacked_stream_no_link_up/1, dialer_presents_cert/1,
   23:          mismatched_header_cannot_poison_cache/1,
   24:          authenticated_coalesced_header_payload_delivered_once/1,
   25:          no_learn_is_monotone_across_streams/1,
   26:          resolve_and_dial_by_pubkey/1, pinned_dial_suppresses_hint_learning/1,
   27:          ordinary_pubkey_dial_rejects_wrong_cert/1,
   28:          connection_is_owned_by_transport/1,
   29:          authenticated_peer_connections/1,
   30:          connection_confirmation_without_stream/1,
   31:          shared_peer_loss_confirmation/1,
   32:          ontology_observer_shares_physical_failure/1,
   33:          terminal_confirmation_preserves_observation_time/1,
   34:          recovery_round_reconfirms_existing_connection/1,
   35:          inbound_owner_death_closes_wire_connection/1,
   36:          observer_confirmation_deadline_releases_pending/1,
   37:          inconclusive_loss_confirmation_is_reobserved/1,
   38:          pinned_reverse_stream_suppresses_hint_learning/1,
   39:          identified_dial_suppresses_hint_learning/1,
   40:          ordinary_dial_still_learns_hint/1,
   41:          pinned_dial_rejects_wrong_cert/1]).
   42: 
   43: -define(PORT, 14599).
   44: -define(SELF, {"127.0.0.1", ?PORT}).
   45: 
   46: all() -> [open_link_succeeds, message_roundtrip, bidirectional_reuse,
   47:           stream_priorities_survive_reopen, priority_mixed_traffic,
   48:           tagged_catchup_open_preserves_pools,
   49:           channel_stream_reset_isolated,
   50:           ordered_send_waits_for_send_ready_fifo,
   51:           connection_death_resolves_pending_waiters,
   52:           inbound_channel_reset_is_scoped,
   53:           explicit_link_retires_with_last_owner,
   54:           pinned_leases_share_link_until_last_release,
   55:           pinned_lease_release_is_connection_exact,
   56:           late_released_link_cannot_consume_replacement_waiter,
   57:           non_dialable_node_id,
   58:           unacked_stream_no_link_up, dialer_presents_cert,
   59:           mismatched_header_cannot_poison_cache,
   60:           authenticated_coalesced_header_payload_delivered_once,
   61:           no_learn_is_monotone_across_streams,
   62:           resolve_and_dial_by_pubkey,
   63:           ordinary_pubkey_dial_rejects_wrong_cert,
   64:           connection_is_owned_by_transport,
   65:           authenticated_peer_connections,
   66:           connection_confirmation_without_stream,
   67:           shared_peer_loss_confirmation,
   68:           ontology_observer_shares_physical_failure,
   69:           terminal_confirmation_preserves_observation_time,
   70:           recovery_round_reconfirms_existing_connection,
   71:           inbound_owner_death_closes_wire_connection,
   72:           observer_confirmation_deadline_releases_pending,
   73:           inconclusive_loss_confirmation_is_reobserved,
   74:           pinned_dial_suppresses_hint_learning,
   75:           pinned_reverse_stream_suppresses_hint_learning,
   76:           identified_dial_suppresses_hint_learning,
   77:           ordinary_dial_still_learns_hint, pinned_dial_rejects_wrong_cert].
   78: 
   79: init_per_suite(Config) ->
   80:     {ok, _} = application:ensure_all_started(gproc),
   81:     {ok, _} = application:ensure_all_started(quic),
   82:     application:load(quod),
   83:     %% Never inherit a developer/node effect journal through the user cache.
   84:     %% The suite owns an isolated CT-private directory, so app startup really
   85:     %% runs every transport case instead of failing before the suite begins.
   86:     EffectJournalDir =
   87:         filename:join(?config(priv_dir, Config), "effect-journal"),
   88:     application:set_env(quod, effect_journal_data_dir, EffectJournalDir),
   89:     %% The foreign history owner is also started by the real application.
   90:     %% Transport tests must not inspect or mutate a developer's retained cache.
   91:     application:set_env(quod, foreign_log,
   92:                         #{cache_dir => filename:join(?config(priv_dir, Config),
   93:                                                       "foreign-history")}),
   94:     %% the node's per-node Ed25519 identity cert — the production transport cert that
   95:     %% quod_quic presents and verifies under mutual TLS (verify => true).
   96:     {ok, #{pubkey := Pub, cert := Cert, key := Key}} = quod_identity:ensure(
   97:         filename:join(?config(priv_dir, Config), "node-identity")),
   98:     true = is_function(Key, 0),
   99:     application:set_env(quod, listen_port, ?PORT),
  100:     application:set_env(quod, node_addr, ?SELF),
  101:     application:set_env(quod, node_pubkey, Pub),
  102:     application:set_env(quod, identity_cert, Cert),
  103:     application:set_env(quod, identity_key, Key),
  104:     {ok, _} = application:ensure_all_started(quod),
  105:     %% The app retains the opaque loaded key; synthetic peers below call the
  106:     %% native TLS library directly and therefore need its native key term.
  107:     [{cert_der, Cert}, {key_term, quod_identity:tls_key(Key)},
  108:      {self_pubkey, Pub} | Config].
  109: 
  110: end_per_suite(_Config) ->
  111:     _ = application:stop(quod),
  112:     %% this suite runs the app IN the CT node (not a peer), so unset the env it set
  113:     %% to avoid leaking a stale cert/port into any later same-node suite.
  114:     _ = [application:unset_env(quod, K)
  115:          || K <- [listen_port, node_addr, node_pubkey, identity_cert, identity_key,
  116:                   effect_journal_data_dir, foreign_log]],
  117:     ok.
  118: 
  119: %% Opening a link to our own listener over loopback yields a usable link pid.
  120: open_link_succeeds(_Config) ->
  121:     {ok, Key} = application:get_env(quod, identity_key),
  122:     true = is_function(Key, 0),
  123:     %% Real OTP status, not just a hand-built report. Both listener and dialer
  124:     %% must still complete mutual TLS from the same loaded opaque identity.
  125:     Transport = quod_reg:where({transport, node}),
  126:     true = is_pid(Transport),
  127:     Status = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format("~p", [sys:get_status(Transport)])),
  128:     nomatch = binary:match(Status, <<"ECPrivateKey">>),
  129:     ok = quod_quic:open_link(?SELF, <<"chan-a">>),
  130:     receive
  131:         {link_up, ?SELF, <<"chan-a">>, LinkPid} when is_pid(LinkPid) -> ok
  132:     after 5000 ->
  133:         ct:fail(no_link_up)
  134:     end.
  135: 
  136: %% Real pooled catch-up streams use direct owner controls, not channel fanout.
  137: tagged_catchup_open_preserves_pools(Config) ->
  138:     Pub = ?config(self_pubkey, Config),
  139:     Ns = <<"catchup-credit-pools">>,
  140:     Channel = quod_catchup:channel(Ns),
  141:     true = quod_reg:reg({quod_catchup, Ns}),
  142:     true = quod_reg:subscribe({channel, Channel}),
  143:     ok = quod_quic:learn(Pub, ?SELF),
  144:     OrdinaryRef = quod_quic:open_link_tagged(Pub, Channel),
  145:     Ordinary = receive {link_up, OrdinaryRef, Pub, Channel, L0} -> L0
  146:                after 5000 -> ct:fail(no_tagged_ordinary_link) end,
  147:     ReuseRef = quod_quic:open_link_tagged(Pub, Channel),
  148:     receive {link_up, ReuseRef, Pub, Channel, Ordinary} -> ok
  149:     after 5000 -> ct:fail(tagged_open_did_not_reuse) end,
  150:     IdentifiedRef = quod_quic:open_link_identified(?SELF, Channel),
  151:     Identified = receive {link_up, IdentifiedRef, Pub, Channel, L1} -> L1
  152:                  after 5000 -> ct:fail(no_identified_credit_link) end,
  153:     PinnedRef = quod_quic:open_link_pinned_lease(Pub, ?SELF, Channel),
  154:     Pinned = receive {link_up, PinnedRef, Pub, Channel, L2} -> L2
  155:              after 5000 -> ct:fail(no_pinned_credit_link) end,
  156:     try
  157:         3 = length(lists:usort([Ordinary, Identified, Pinned])),
  158:         Binding = make_ref(),
  159:         ok = quod_link:bind_catchup(Ordinary, Binding),
  160:         Grant = receive {catchup_credit, Ordinary, Binding, G} -> G
  161:                 after 5000 -> ct:fail(no_loopback_credit) end,
  162:         ReqId = <<60:128>>,
  163:         ok = quod_link:request_page(Ordinary, Binding, Grant, ReqId, {range, 1, 1}),
  164:         {ServingLink, Operation} =
  165:             receive {catchup_request, InLink, Op, {range, 1, 1}, StartedMs}
  166:                       when is_integer(StartedMs) -> {InLink, Op}
  167:             after 5000 -> ct:fail(no_direct_catchup_request) end,
  168:         ok = quod_link:test_fail_next_ordered(ServingLink, send_queue_full),
  169:         ok = quod_link:complete_page(ServingLink, Operation, {ok, [], 0, done}),
  170:         {ok, {Conn, Sid}} = quod_link:test_transport(ServingLink),
  171:         receive
  172:             {catchup_page_sent, ServingLink, Operation} -> ct:fail(premature_send_acceptance);
  173:             {catchup_page, Ordinary, _, _, _, _, _} -> ct:fail(page_overtook_refusal)
  174:         after 30 -> ok end,
  175:         {links, [ConnOwner]} = process_info(ServingLink, links),
  176:         ConnOwner ! {quic, Conn, {send_ready, Sid}},
  177:         receive {catchup_page_sent, ServingLink, Operation} -> ok
  178:         after 5000 -> ct:fail(no_page_send_acceptance) end,
  179:         Next = receive
  180:                    {catchup_page, Ordinary, Binding, Grant, ReqId, {ok, [], 0, done}, N} -> N
  181:                after 5000 -> ct:fail(no_loopback_page) end,
  182:         true = Next =/= Grant,
  183:         receive {quod_message, _, Channel, _} -> ct:fail(catchup_fanout_survived)
  184:         after 0 -> ok end,
  185:         Missing = <<255:256>>,
  186:         MissingRef = quod_quic:open_link_tagged(Missing, Channel),
  187:         receive {link_error, MissingRef, Missing, Channel} -> ok
  188:         after 5000 -> ct:fail(no_tagged_unresolved_error) end
  189:     after
  190:         quod_link:close(Ordinary),
  191:         quod_link:close(Identified),
  192:         quod_quic:release_link_pinned(Pub, ?SELF, Channel, PinnedRef),
  193:         quod_reg:unsubscribe({channel, Channel}),
  194:         gproc:unreg(quod_reg:name({quod_catchup, Ns}))
  195:     end.
  196: 
  197: stream_priorities_survive_reopen(_Config) ->
  198:     lists:foreach(
  199:       fun({Term, Priority}) ->
  200:           Channel = term_to_binary(Term, [deterministic]),
  201:           true = quod_reg:subscribe({channel, Channel}),
  202:           try
  203:               lists:foreach(
  204:                 fun(_) ->
  205:                     Link = open_priority_link(Channel),
  206:                     {ok, {Conn, Sid}} = quod_link:test_transport(Link),
  207:                     {ok, Priority} = quic:get_stream_priority(Conn, Sid),
  208:                     ok = quod_link:send(Link, <<"priority-check">>),
  209:                     Inbound = receive
  210:                         {quod_message, {_, In}, Channel, <<"priority-check">>} -> In
  211:                     after 5000 -> ct:fail(no_priority_delivery) end,
  212:                     {ok, {RemoteConn, RemoteSid}} = quod_link:test_transport(Inbound),
  213:                     {ok, Priority} = quic:get_stream_priority(RemoteConn, RemoteSid),
  214:                     Ref = monitor(process, Link),
  215:                     ok = quod_link:close(Link),
  216:                     receive {'DOWN', Ref, process, Link, _} -> ok
  217:                     after 5000 -> ct:fail(priority_link_not_closed) end
  218:                 end, [first, replacement])
  219:           after quod_reg:unsubscribe({channel, Channel}) end
  220:       end, [{{log, <<"priority-test">>}, {0, false}},
  221:             {{feed, <<"priority-test">>}, {4, true}},
  222:             {quod_client_goal_v1, {6, true}}]).
  223: 
  224: priority_mixed_traffic(_Config) ->
  225:     LogChannel = term_to_binary({log, <<"priority-load">>}, [deterministic]),
  226:     BulkChannel = <<"priority-load-application">>,
  227:     true = quod_reg:subscribe({channel, LogChannel}),
  228:     true = quod_reg:subscribe({channel, BulkChannel}),
  229:     Log = open_priority_link(LogChannel),
  230:     Bulk = open_priority_link(BulkChannel),
  231:     {ok, {Conn, _}} = quod_link:test_transport(Log),
  232:     {ok, {Conn, _}} = quod_link:test_transport(Bulk),
  233:     Parent = self(), Tag = make_ref(),
  234:     {Worker, Monitor} = spawn_monitor(
  235:       fun() ->
  236:           Payload = binary:copy(<<"b">>, 65536),
  237:           lists:foreach(
  238:             fun(N) ->
  239:                 ok = quod_link:send_reliable(Bulk, Payload, 5000),
  240:                 case N of 1 -> Parent ! {Tag, started}; _ -> ok end
  241:             end, lists:seq(1, 64))
  242:       end),
  243:     try
  244:         receive {Tag, started} -> ok
  245:         after 5000 -> ct:fail(bulk_never_started) end,
  246:         lists:foreach(
  247:           fun(N) ->
  248:               Payload = <<N:32>>,
  249:               ok = quod_link:send(Log, Payload),
  250:               receive {quod_message, _, LogChannel, Payload} -> ok
  251:               after 5000 -> ct:fail(consensus_channel_starved) end
  252:           end, lists:seq(1, 32)),
  253:         receive {'DOWN', Monitor, process, Worker, normal} -> ok;
  254:                 {'DOWN', Monitor, process, Worker, Reason} -> ct:fail({bulk_failed, Reason})
  255:         after 10000 -> ct:fail(bulk_producer_stalled) end,
  256:         lists:foreach(
  257:           fun(_) ->
  258:               receive {quod_message, _, BulkChannel, Payload}
  259:                         when byte_size(Payload) =:= 65536 -> ok
  260:               after 10000 -> ct:fail(bulk_delivery_stalled) end
  261:           end, lists:seq(1, 64))
  262:     after
  263:         exit(Worker, kill), demonitor(Monitor, [flush]),
  264:         quod_link:close(Log), quod_link:close(Bulk),
  265:         quod_reg:unsubscribe({channel, LogChannel}),
  266:         quod_reg:unsubscribe({channel, BulkChannel})
  267:     end.
  268: 
  269: open_priority_link(Channel) ->
  270:     ok = quod_quic:open_link(?SELF, Channel),
  271:     receive {link_up, ?SELF, Channel, Link} -> Link
  272:     after 5000 -> ct:fail(no_priority_link) end.
  273: 
  274: %% Ordinary payloads still arrive through the existing channel property.
  275: message_roundtrip(_Config) ->
  276:     true = quod_reg:subscribe({channel, <<"chan-b">>}),
  277:     ok = quod_quic:open_link(?SELF, <<"chan-b">>),
  278:     LinkPid = receive
  279:                   {link_up, ?SELF, <<"chan-b">>, L} -> L
  280:               after 5000 -> ct:fail(no_link_up)
  281:               end,
  282:     ok = quod_link:send(LinkPid, <<"hello">>),
  283:     receive
  284:         {quod_message, {_Peer, _InLink}, <<"chan-b">>, <<"hello">>} -> ok
  285:     after 5000 ->
  286:         ct:fail(no_message)
  287:     end.
  288: 
  289: %% One stream is bidirectional: a reply sent on the *inbound* link arrives back
  290: %% on the *outbound* link — proving a peer pair needs only one stream per channel.
  291: bidirectional_reuse(_Config) ->
  292:     true = quod_reg:subscribe({channel, <<"chan-c">>}),
  293:     ok = quod_quic:open_link(?SELF, <<"chan-c">>),
  294:     OutLink = receive
  295:                   {link_up, ?SELF, <<"chan-c">>, L} -> L
  296:               after 5000 -> ct:fail(no_link_up)
  297:               end,
  298:     %% out -> in
  299:     ok = quod_link:send(OutLink, <<"ping">>),
  300:     InLink = receive
  301:                  {quod_message, {_, In}, <<"chan-c">>, <<"ping">>} -> In
  302:              after 5000 -> ct:fail(no_ping)
  303:              end,
  304:     %% in -> out, on the SAME stream
  305:     ok = quod_link:send(InLink, <<"pong">>),
  306:     receive
  307:         {quod_message, {_, OutLink}, <<"chan-c">>, <<"pong">>} -> ok
  308:     after 5000 ->
  309:         ct:fail(no_pong)
  310:     end.
  311: 
  312: %% `{log,Ns}` consensus and `{ingress,Ns}` relay links are distinct streams on
  313: %% the same QUIC connection. Deterministically force the real relay link through
  314: %% its ordered-send failure arm: it counts the refusal, resets its actual QUIC
  315: %% Sid, and exits. Consensus must stay live and deliver after that reset.
  316: channel_stream_reset_isolated(_Config) ->
  317:     LogChan = <<"isolation-log">>,
  318:     IngressChan = <<"isolation-ingress">>,
  319:     true = quod_reg:subscribe({channel, LogChan}),
  320:     true = quod_reg:subscribe({channel, IngressChan}),
  321:     ok = quod_quic:open_link(?SELF, LogChan),
  322:     LogLink =
  323:         receive
  324:             {link_up, ?SELF, LogChan, LogPid} -> LogPid
  325:         after 5000 ->
  326:             ct:fail(no_log_link)
  327:         end,
  328:     ok = quod_quic:open_link(?SELF, IngressChan),
  329:     IngressLink =
  330:         receive
  331:             {link_up, ?SELF, IngressChan, IngressPid} -> IngressPid
  332:         after 5000 ->
  333:             ct:fail(no_ingress_link)
  334:         end,
  335:     true = LogLink =/= IngressLink,
  336:     ok = quod_link:send(LogLink, <<"before-reset">>),
  337:     receive
  338:         {quod_message, {_, _}, LogChan, <<"before-reset">>} -> ok
  339:     after 5000 ->
  340:         ct:fail(no_log_before_reset)
  341:     end,
  342:     IngressRef = monitor(process, IngressLink),
  343:     ok = quod_link:test_fail_next_ordered(
  344:            IngressLink, backpressure_timeout),
  345:     ok = quod_link:send_ordered(
  346:            IngressLink, <<"forced-ordered-failure">>),
  347:     receive
  348:         {'DOWN', IngressRef, process, IngressLink,
  349:          {ordered_send_failed, backpressure_timeout}} ->
  350:             ok
  351:     after 5000 ->
  352:         ct:fail(ingress_ordered_failure_did_not_reset)
  353:     end,
  354:     true = is_process_alive(LogLink),
  355:     ok = quod_link:send(LogLink, <<"after-reset">>),
  356:     receive
  357:         {quod_message, {_, _}, LogChan, <<"after-reset">>} -> ok
  358:     after 5000 ->
  359:         ct:fail(consensus_stream_died_with_ingress)
  360:     end.
  361: 
  362: %% A transient ordered-send refusal parks the exact stream FIFO. Nothing polls:
  363: %% the QUIC owner's send_ready event is routed by quod_conn to that link, which
  364: %% retries the head and then flushes its successor in order. A reliable send on
  365: %% the same path also reports local acceptance to its caller.
  366: ordered_send_waits_for_send_ready_fifo(_Config) ->
  367:     Channel = <<"send-ready-fifo">>,
  368:     true = quod_reg:subscribe({channel, Channel}),
  369:     try
  370:         ok = quod_quic:open_link(?SELF, Channel),
  371:         Link =
  372:             receive
  373:                 {link_up, ?SELF, Channel, Pid} -> Pid
  374:             after 5000 ->
  375:                 ct:fail(no_send_ready_link)
  376:             end,
  377:         {links, [ConnOwner]} = process_info(Link, links),
  378:         {ok, {Conn, Sid}} = quod_link:test_transport(Link),
  379:         %% The existing failure seam can also inject a *transient* refusal. It
  380:         %% is consumed by the next ordered attempt, which must park rather than
  381:         %% reset the stream.
  382:         ok = quod_link:test_fail_next_ordered(Link, send_queue_full),
  383:         ok = quod_link:send_ordered(Link, <<"first">>),
  384:         ok = quod_link:send_ordered(Link, <<"second">>),
  385:         receive
  386:             {quod_message, _, Channel, Unexpected} ->
  387:                 ct:fail({sent_before_send_ready, Unexpected})
  388:         after 50 ->
  389:             ok
  390:         end,
  391:         ConnOwner ! {quic, Conn, {send_ready, Sid}},
  392:         receive
  393:             {quod_message, {_, _}, Channel, <<"first">>} -> ok
  394:         after 5000 ->
  395:             ct:fail(first_not_woken)
  396:         end,
  397:         receive
  398:             {quod_message, {_, _}, Channel, <<"second">>} -> ok
  399:         after 5000 ->
  400:             ct:fail(second_not_fifo)
  401:         end,
  402:         ok = quod_link:send_reliable(Link, <<"reliable">>, 1000),
  403:         receive
  404:             {quod_message, {_, _}, Channel, <<"reliable">>} -> ok
  405:         after 5000 ->
  406:             ct:fail(reliable_not_delivered)
  407:         end,
  408:         true = is_process_alive(Link)
  409:     after
  410:         true = quod_reg:unsubscribe({channel, Channel})
  411:     end.
  412: 
  413: %% A connection can close before its opening streams emit their linked EXITs.
  414: %% Both accepted callers must still receive one correlated link_error directly
  415: %% from the connection ownership boundary; neither may remain parked forever.
  416: connection_death_resolves_pending_waiters(Config) ->
  417:     CertDer = ?config(cert_der, Config),
  418:     KeyTerm = ?config(key_term, Config),
  419:     Test = self(),
  420:     Handler =
  421:         fun(Conn) ->
  422:             Test ! {pending_waiter_server_conn, Conn},
  423:             {ok, spawn(fun Ignore() -> receive _ -> Ignore() end end)}
  424:         end,
  425:     Port = 14595,
  426:     Target = {"127.0.0.1", Port},
  427:     Channel = <<"pending-waiters-die-with-conn">>,
  428:     {ok, _} = quic:start_server(
  429:                 pending_waiter_server, Port,
  430:                 #{cert => CertDer, key => KeyTerm,
  431:                   alpn => [<<"quod">>], connection_handler => Handler}),
  432:     try
  433:         %% Establish the connection owner through the public authority, then add
  434:         %% two ref-correlated opens directly. The stats request is a mailbox
  435:         %% barrier from the same sender, proving both opens were accepted before
  436:         %% the server connection is closed.
  437:         ok = quod_quic:open_link(Target, Channel),
  438:         ServerConn =
  439:             receive
  440:                 {pending_waiter_server_conn, C} -> C
  441:             after 5000 ->
  442:                 ct:fail(no_pending_waiter_connection)
  443:             end,
  444:         Transport = quod_reg:where({transport, node}),
  445:         TransportState = sys:get_state(Transport),
  446:         Conns = element(tuple_size(TransportState), TransportState),
  447:         ConnOwner = maps:get(Target, Conns),
  448:         ConnOwnerRef = monitor(process, ConnOwner),
  449:         Ref1 = make_ref(),
  450:         Ref2 = make_ref(),
  451:         ok = quod_conn:open_link(ConnOwner, Channel, {self(), Ref1}),
  452:         ok = quod_conn:open_link(ConnOwner, Channel, {self(), Ref2}),
  453:         Barrier = make_ref(),
  454:         ConnOwner ! {transport_stats, self(), Barrier},
  455:         receive {Barrier, _} -> ok after 2000 -> ct:fail(no_conn_barrier) end,
  456:         ok = quic:close(ServerConn, normal),
  457:         receive
  458:             {link_error, Ref1, Target, Channel} -> ok
  459:         after 5000 ->
  460:             ct:fail(first_waiter_not_resolved)
  461:         end,
  462:         receive
  463:             {link_error, Ref2, Target, Channel} -> ok
  464:         after 5000 ->
  465:             ct:fail(second_waiter_not_resolved)
  466:         end,
  467:         receive
  468:             {link_error, Ref1, Target, Channel} ->
  469:                 ct:fail(first_waiter_resolved_twice);
  470:             {link_error, Ref2, Target, Channel} ->
  471:                 ct:fail(second_waiter_resolved_twice)
  472:         after 100 ->
  473:             ok
  474:         end,
  475:         receive
  476:             {'DOWN', ConnOwnerRef, process, ConnOwner, _} -> ok
  477:         after 2000 ->
  478:             ct:fail(terminal_connection_not_retired)
  479:         end,
  480:         %% Removal precedes the terminal ACK/exit. A later public open must
  481:         %% therefore create a different connection generation, never select
  482:         %% the dead pid that produced the two errors above.
  483:         ReplacementChannel = <<"replacement-after-terminal">>,
  484:         ok = quod_quic:open_link(Target, ReplacementChannel),
  485:         ReplacementServerConn =
  486:             receive
  487:                 {pending_waiter_server_conn, C2} -> C2
  488:             after 5000 ->
  489:                 ct:fail(no_replacement_connection)
  490:             end,
  491:         ReplacementState = sys:get_state(Transport),
  492:         ReplacementConns =
  493:             element(tuple_size(ReplacementState), ReplacementState),
  494:         ReplacementOwner = maps:get(Target, ReplacementConns),
  495:         true = ReplacementOwner =/= ConnOwner,
  496:         ok = quic:close(ReplacementServerConn, normal)
  497:     after
  498:         _ = quic:stop_server(pending_waiter_server)
  499:     end.
  500: 
  501: %% Channel-owner restart is a transport-wide broadcast but a link-local
  502: %% decision: only a matching peer-opened stream resets. Outbound links ignore
  503: %% the command, and another inbound channel remains usable.
  504: inbound_channel_reset_is_scoped(_Config) ->
  505:     ResetChannel = <<"reset-inbound-exact">>,
  506:     OtherChannel = <<"reset-inbound-other">>,
  507:     true = quod_reg:subscribe({channel, ResetChannel}),
  508:     true = quod_reg:subscribe({channel, OtherChannel}),
  509:     try
  510:         ok = quod_quic:open_link(?SELF, ResetChannel),
  511:         ResetOut =
  512:             receive
  513:                 {link_up, ?SELF, ResetChannel, Pid1} -> Pid1
  514:             after 5000 -> ct:fail(no_reset_outbound)
  515:             end,
  516:         ok = quod_quic:open_link(?SELF, OtherChannel),
  517:         OtherOut =
  518:             receive
  519:                 {link_up, ?SELF, OtherChannel, Pid2} -> Pid2
  520:             after 5000 -> ct:fail(no_other_outbound)
  521:             end,
  522:         ok = quod_link:send(ResetOut, <<"find-reset-inbound">>),
  523:         ResetIn =
  524:             receive
  525:                 {quod_message, {_, In1}, ResetChannel,
  526:                  <<"find-reset-inbound">>} -> In1
  527:             after 5000 -> ct:fail(no_reset_inbound)
  528:             end,
  529:         ok = quod_link:send(OtherOut, <<"find-other-inbound">>),
  530:         OtherIn =
  531:             receive
  532:                 {quod_message, {_, In2}, OtherChannel,
  533:                  <<"find-other-inbound">>} -> In2
  534:             after 5000 -> ct:fail(no_other_inbound)
  535:             end,
  536:         %% Directly prove the two negative guards before exercising broadcast.
  537:         ResetOut ! {reset_inbound_channel, ResetChannel},
  538:         {ok, _} = quod_link:test_transport(ResetOut),
  539:         ResetIn ! {reset_inbound_channel, OtherChannel},
  540:         {ok, _} = quod_link:test_transport(ResetIn),
  541:         ResetInRef = monitor(process, ResetIn),
  542:         OtherInRef = monitor(process, OtherIn),
  543:         OtherOutRef = monitor(process, OtherOut),
  544:         ok = quod_conn:reset_inbound_channel(ResetChannel),
  545:         receive
  546:             {'DOWN', ResetInRef, process, ResetIn, normal} -> ok;
  547:             {'DOWN', ResetInRef, process, ResetIn, Reason} ->
  548:                 ct:fail({bad_reset_reason, Reason})
  549:         after 5000 ->
  550:             ct:fail(matching_inbound_not_reset)
  551:         end,
  552:         receive
  553:             {'DOWN', OtherInRef, process, OtherIn, Reason2} ->
  554:                 ct:fail({other_inbound_reset, Reason2});
  555:             {'DOWN', OtherOutRef, process, OtherOut, Reason3} ->
  556:                 ct:fail({other_outbound_reset, Reason3})
  557:         after 100 ->
  558:             ok
  559:         end,
  560:         ok = quod_link:send(OtherOut, <<"other-still-live">>),
  561:         receive
  562:             {quod_message, {_, OtherIn}, OtherChannel,
  563:              <<"other-still-live">>} -> ok
  564:         after 5000 ->
  565:             ct:fail(other_channel_not_live)
  566:         end,
  567:         demonitor(OtherInRef, [flush]),
  568:         demonitor(OtherOutRef, [flush])
  569:     after
  570:         true = quod_reg:unsubscribe({channel, ResetChannel}),
  571:         true = quod_reg:unsubscribe({channel, OtherChannel})
  572:     end.
  573: 
  574: %% An explicit opener is the owner of its returned link. Monitoring that owner
  575: %% closes the old is_process_alive/link_up race: even when it dies immediately
  576: %% after receiving link_up, the connection retires the waiter-only stream rather
  577: %% than caching an unowned link.
  578: explicit_link_retires_with_last_owner(_Config) ->
  579:     Channel = <<"explicit-link-owner">>,
  580:     Parent = self(),
  581:     {Opener, OpenerRef} =
  582:         spawn_monitor(fun() ->
  583:             ok = quod_quic:open_link(?SELF, Channel),
  584:             receive
  585:                 {link_up, ?SELF, Channel, LinkPid} ->
  586:                     Parent ! {owned_link, self(), LinkPid},
  587:                     receive release_owner -> ok end
  588:             after 5000 ->
  589:                 Parent ! {owned_link_failed, self()}
  590:             end
  591:         end),
  592:     Link =
  593:         receive
  594:             {owned_link, Opener, Pid} -> Pid;
  595:             {owned_link_failed, Opener} -> ct:fail(no_owned_link)
  596:         after 6000 ->
  597:             ct:fail(no_owned_link_result)
  598:         end,
  599:     LinkRef = monitor(process, Link),
  600:     Opener ! release_owner,
  601:     receive
  602:         {'DOWN', OpenerRef, process, Opener, normal} -> ok
  603:     after 1000 ->
  604:         ct:fail(opener_did_not_exit)
  605:     end,
  606:     receive
  607:         {'DOWN', LinkRef, process, Link, normal} -> ok;
  608:         {'DOWN', LinkRef, process, Link, Reason} ->
  609:             ct:fail({bad_owned_link_exit, Reason})
  610:     after 3000 ->
  611:         ct:fail(waiter_only_link_was_cached)
  612:     end.
  613: 
  614: %% Two logical requests may deliberately reuse one pinned stream. Releasing
  615: %% one exact `{Pid,OpenRef}` lease must leave the shared link usable; releasing
  616: %% the final lease retires it.
  617: pinned_leases_share_link_until_last_release(Config) ->
  618:     Pub = ?config(self_pubkey, Config),
  619:     Channel = <<"pinned-shared-request-leases">>,
  620:     true = quod_reg:subscribe({channel, Channel}),
  621:     try
  622:         Ref1 = quod_quic:open_link_pinned_lease(Pub, ?SELF, Channel),
  623:         Link = receive
  624:                    {link_up, Ref1, Pub, Channel, Pid1} -> Pid1
  625:                after 5000 -> ct:fail(no_first_pinned_lease)
  626:                end,
  627:         Ref2 = quod_quic:open_link_pinned_lease(Pub, ?SELF, Channel),
  628:         Link = receive
  629:                    {link_up, Ref2, Pub, Channel, Pid2} -> Pid2
  630:                after 5000 -> ct:fail(no_shared_pinned_lease)
  631:                end,
  632:         LinkRef = monitor(process, Link),
  633:         ok = quod_quic:release_link_pinned(Pub, ?SELF, Channel, Ref1),
  634:         receive
  635:             {'DOWN', LinkRef, process, Link, Reason1} ->
  636:                 ct:fail({shared_link_closed_on_first_release, Reason1})
  637:         after 100 ->
  638:             ok
  639:         end,
  640:         ok = quod_link:send(Link, <<"still-leased">>),
  641:         receive
  642:             {quod_message, {_, _}, Channel, <<"still-leased">>} -> ok
  643:         after 5000 ->
  644:             ct:fail(shared_link_not_usable_after_first_release)
  645:         end,
  646:         ok = quod_quic:release_link_pinned(Pub, ?SELF, Channel, Ref2),
  647:         receive
  648:             {'DOWN', LinkRef, process, Link, normal} -> ok;
  649:             {'DOWN', LinkRef, process, Link, Reason2} ->
  650:                 ct:fail({bad_final_lease_exit, Reason2})
  651:         after 3000 ->
  652:             ct:fail(shared_link_survived_final_release)
  653:         end
  654:     after
  655:         true = quod_reg:unsubscribe({channel, Channel})
  656:     end.
  657: 
  658: %% Pinned pool identity includes the endpoint. The same peer/channel on two
  659: %% endpoints therefore owns two connections and two links; releasing one lease
  660: %% must retire only that exact connection's link.
  661: pinned_lease_release_is_connection_exact(Config) ->
  662:     Pub = ?config(self_pubkey, Config),
  663:     Cert = ?config(cert_der, Config),
  664:     Key = ?config(key_term, Config),
  665:     Port = 14594,
  666:     OtherEndpoint = {"127.0.0.1", Port},
  667:     Channel = <<"pinned-endpoint-exact-lease">>,
  668:     Owner = spawn(fun second_conn_owner/0),
  669:     Handler =
  670:         fun(Conn) ->
  671:             {ok, quod_conn:start_inbound(
  672:                    Conn, {Pub, OtherEndpoint}, Owner)}
  673:         end,
  674:     {ok, _} = quic:start_server(
  675:                 pinned_lease_second_endpoint, Port,
  676:                 maps:merge(
  677:                   #{cert => Cert, key => Key, verify => true,
  678:                     alpn => [<<"quod">>], connection_handler => Handler},
  679:                   quod_quic:liveness_opts())),
  680:     true = quod_reg:subscribe({channel, Channel}),
  681:     try
  682:         Ref1 = quod_quic:open_link_pinned_lease(Pub, ?SELF, Channel),
  683:         Link1 = receive
  684:                     {link_up, Ref1, Pub, Channel, Pid1} -> Pid1
  685:                 after 5000 -> ct:fail(no_primary_endpoint_lease)
  686:                 end,
  687:         Ref2 = quod_quic:open_link_pinned_lease(
  688:                  Pub, OtherEndpoint, Channel),
  689:         Link2 = receive
  690:                     {link_up, Ref2, Pub, Channel, Pid2} -> Pid2
  691:                 after 5000 -> ct:fail(no_secondary_endpoint_lease)
  692:                 end,
  693:         true = Link1 =/= Link2,
  694:         Link1Ref = monitor(process, Link1),
  695:         Link2Ref = monitor(process, Link2),
  696:         ok = quod_quic:release_link_pinned(Pub, ?SELF, Channel, Ref1),
  697:         receive
  698:             {'DOWN', Link1Ref, process, Link1, normal} -> ok;
  699:             {'DOWN', Link1Ref, process, Link1, Reason1} ->
  700:                 ct:fail({bad_primary_lease_exit, Reason1})
  701:         after 3000 ->
  702:             ct:fail(primary_endpoint_lease_not_released)
  703:         end,
  704:         true = is_process_alive(Link2),
  705:         ok = quod_link:send(Link2, <<"secondary-still-live">>),
  706:         receive
  707:             {quod_message, {_, _}, Channel,
  708:              <<"secondary-still-live">>} -> ok
  709:         after 5000 ->
  710:             ct:fail(secondary_endpoint_link_was_disturbed)
  711:         end,
  712:         ok = quod_quic:release_link_pinned(
  713:                Pub, OtherEndpoint, Channel, Ref2),
  714:         receive
  715:             {'DOWN', Link2Ref, process, Link2, normal} -> ok;
  716:             {'DOWN', Link2Ref, process, Link2, Reason2} ->
  717:                 ct:fail({bad_secondary_lease_exit, Reason2})
  718:         after 3000 ->
  719:             ct:fail(secondary_endpoint_lease_not_released)
  720:         end
  721:     after
  722:         true = quod_reg:unsubscribe({channel, Channel}),
  723:         _ = quic:stop_server(pinned_lease_second_endpoint),
  724:         Owner ! stop
  725:     end.
  726: 
  727: second_conn_owner() ->
  728:     receive
  729:         {conn_terminal, ConnPid, Ref} ->
  730:             ConnPid ! {conn_terminal_ack, self(), Ref},
  731:             second_conn_owner();
  732:         stop ->
  733:             ok;
  734:         _Other ->
  735:             second_conn_owner()
  736:     end.
  737: 
  738: %% Releasing the last L1 lease can be immediately followed by a replacement L2
  739: %% open on the same connection/channel. If L1's already-queued link_up arrives
  740: %% first, it must not consume L2's exact waiter or become the cached link.
  741: late_released_link_cannot_consume_replacement_waiter(_Config) ->
  742:     Channel = <<"late-l1-before-replacement-l2">>,
  743:     Peer = crypto:strong_rand_bytes(32),
  744:     Parent = self(),
  745:     OldLink = spawn(fun() -> link_probe(Parent) end),
  746:     NewLink = spawn(fun() -> link_probe(Parent) end),
  747:     #{ref := Ref, pending_after_old := true,
  748:       pending_after_new := false, active := NewLink} =
  749:         quod_conn:test_late_link_up_generation(
  750:           Channel, Peer, OldLink, NewLink),
  751:     receive
  752:         {probe_closed, OldLink} -> ok
  753:     after 1000 ->
  754:         ct:fail(stale_generation_link_not_closed)
  755:     end,
  756:     receive
  757:         {link_up, Ref, Peer, Channel, NewLink} -> ok;
  758:         {link_up, Ref, Peer, Channel, OldLink} ->
  759:             ct:fail(stale_generation_consumed_replacement_waiter)
  760:     after 1000 ->
  761:         ct:fail(replacement_waiter_not_notified)
  762:     end,
  763:     NewLink ! stop.
  764: 
  765: link_probe(Parent) ->
  766:     receive
  767:         close -> Parent ! {probe_closed, self()};
  768:         stop -> ok;
  769:         _Other -> link_probe(Parent)
  770:     end.
  771: 
  772: %% A peer that completes the QUIC handshake but never ACKs the opened stream must
  773: %% NOT produce a link_up — the opener gets link_error after the ack timeout. This is
  774: %% the liveness ACK: a connection alone is not a live link; only the peer's ack is.
  775: %% (A revert to optimistic link_up would make this test see link_up and fail.)
  776: unacked_stream_no_link_up(Config) ->
  777:     CertDer = ?config(cert_der, Config),
  778:     KeyTerm = ?config(key_term, Config),
  779:     %% raw QUIC server that completes handshakes but whose owner ignores every
  780:     %% stream event (so it never sends the ack frame quod_link expects).
  781:     Handler = fun(_Conn) -> {ok, spawn(fun Ignore() -> receive _ -> Ignore() end end)} end,
  782:     {ok, _} = quic:start_server(raw_noack, 14598,
  783:                                 #{cert => CertDer, key => KeyTerm,
  784:                                   alpn => [<<"quod">>], connection_handler => Handler}),
  785:     Dead = {"127.0.0.1", 14598},
  786:     try
  787:         ok = quod_quic:open_link(Dead, <<"chan-noack">>),
  788:         receive
  789:             {link_up, Dead, <<"chan-noack">>, _} -> ct:fail(unexpected_link_up_without_ack);
  790:             {link_error, Dead, <<"chan-noack">>} -> ok
  791:         after 9000 -> ct:fail(no_link_error)     %% ack timeout is 5s -> link_error well within 9s
  792:         end
  793:     after
  794:         _ = quic:stop_server(raw_noack)
  795:     end.
  796: 
  797: %% Mutual TLS: when quod_quic dials a peer it PRESENTS its own identity cert, which a
  798: %% verify=>true server reads via quic:peercert/1 — proving the dialer authenticates
  799: %% itself (not just verify=>false). The recovered pubkey is the node's identity key.
  800: %% (Guards against a regression that drops the client cert or flips verify off.)
  801: dialer_presents_cert(Config) ->
  802:     SelfPub = ?config(self_pubkey, Config),
  803:     CertDer = ?config(cert_der, Config),
  804:     KeyTerm = ?config(key_term, Config),
  805:     Test = self(),
  806:     %% a verify=>true server (like quod_quic's own) that hands us each accepted Conn so
  807:     %% we can inspect the client cert it received.
  808:     Handler = fun(Conn) -> Test ! {srv_conn, Conn},
  809:                            {ok, spawn(fun Ignore() -> receive _ -> Ignore() end end)} end,
  810:     {ok, _} = quic:start_server(verify_srv, 14597,
  811:                                 #{cert => CertDer, key => KeyTerm, verify => true,
  812:                                   alpn => [<<"quod">>], connection_handler => Handler}),
  813:     Peer = {"127.0.0.1", 14597},
  814:     try
  815:         %% the link won't come up (the server ignores the stream) — we only need the
  816:         %% handshake, where our client cert is presented + verified.
  817:         ok = quod_quic:open_link(Peer, <<"chan-mtls">>),
  818:         SConn = receive {srv_conn, C} -> C after 5000 -> ct:fail(no_server_conn) end,
  819:         {ok, PeerCert} = peercert_retry(SConn, 40),
  820:         case quod_identity:pubkey_of_cert(PeerCert) of
  821:             {ok, SelfPub} -> ok;
  822:             Other         -> ct:fail({peercert_pubkey_mismatch, Other})
  823:         end
  824:     after
  825:         _ = quic:stop_server(verify_srv)
  826:     end.
  827: 
  828: peercert_retry(Conn, 0) -> quic:peercert(Conn);
  829: peercert_retry(Conn, N) ->
  830:     case quic:peercert(Conn) of
  831:         {ok, _} = R -> R;
  832:         _           -> timer:sleep(50), peercert_retry(Conn, N - 1)
  833:     end.
  834: 
  835: %% A structurally valid header is not authenticated until its claimed key is
  836: %% compared with the connection's client certificate. Learning before that bind
  837: %% lets one valid-cert node overwrite another key's shared address hint.
  838: mismatched_header_cannot_poison_cache(_Config) ->
  839:     {ActualPub, _} = ActualKeyPair = quod_identity:generate(),
  840:     ActualCert = quod_identity:mint_cert(ActualKeyPair),
  841:     ActualKey = quod_identity:key_term(ActualKeyPair),
  842:     ForgedPub = crypto:strong_rand_bytes(32),
  843:     true = ForgedPub =/= ActualPub,
  844:     Existing = {"127.0.0.1", 14448},
  845:     Claimed = {"127.0.0.1", 24448},
  846:     Channel = <<"forged-header">>,
  847:     Payload = <<"must-not-escape-before-auth">>,
  848:     true = quod_reg:subscribe({channel, Channel}),
  849:     ok = quod_quic:learn(ForgedPub, Existing),
  850:     try
  851:         {ok, Conn} = quic:connect(
  852:                        element(1, ?SELF), element(2, ?SELF),
  853:                        #{verify => false, cert => ActualCert, key => ActualKey,
  854:                          alpn => [<<"quod">>]}, self()),
  855:         receive
  856:             {quic, Conn, {connected, _}} -> ok
  857:         after 5000 -> ct:fail(no_mismatch_connection)
  858:         end,
  859:         {ok, Sid} = quic:open_stream(Conn),
  860:         ConnRef = monitor(process, Conn),
  861:         Header = quod_link:header(
  862:                    {ForgedPub, Claimed}, Channel, learn),
  863:         Packet = <<Header/binary,
  864:                    (quod_link:frame(Payload))/binary>>,
  865:         ok = quic:send_data(Conn, Sid, Packet, false),
  866:         receive
  867:             {quod_message, _, Channel, Payload} ->
  868:                 ct:fail(payload_published_before_identity_bind)
  869:         after 200 ->
  870:             ok
  871:         end,
  872:         {ok, Existing} = quod_quic:resolve(ForgedPub),
  873:         receive
  874:             {'DOWN', ConnRef, process, Conn, _} -> ok
  875:         after 5000 ->
  876:             ct:fail(rejected_identity_connection_not_closed)
  877:         end,
  878:         ok
  879:     after
  880:         true = quod_reg:unsubscribe({channel, Channel})
  881:     end.
  882: 
  883: %% Header authentication is a barrier, not a payload drop: a matching client
  884: %% certificate/header pair may publish coalesced bytes exactly once after bind.
  885: authenticated_coalesced_header_payload_delivered_once(_Config) ->
  886:     {ActualPub, _} = ActualKeyPair = quod_identity:generate(),
  887:     ActualCert = quod_identity:mint_cert(ActualKeyPair),
  888:     ActualKey = quod_identity:key_term(ActualKeyPair),
  889:     Channel = <<"authenticated-coalesced">>,
  890:     Payload = <<"after-auth-only">>,
  891:     true = quod_reg:subscribe({channel, Channel}),
  892:     try
  893:         {ok, Conn} = quic:connect(
  894:                        element(1, ?SELF), element(2, ?SELF),
  895:                        #{verify => false, cert => ActualCert, key => ActualKey,
  896:                          alpn => [<<"quod">>]}, self()),
  897:         receive
  898:             {quic, Conn, {connected, _}} -> ok
  899:         after 5000 -> ct:fail(no_authenticated_connection)
  900:         end,
  901:         {ok, Sid} = quic:open_stream(Conn),
  902:         Header = quod_link:header(
  903:                    {ActualPub, {"127.0.0.1", 24449}},
  904:                    Channel, no_learn),
  905:         Packet = <<Header/binary,
  906:                    (quod_link:frame(Payload))/binary>>,
  907:         ok = quic:send_data(Conn, Sid, Packet, false),
  908:         receive
  909:             {quod_message, {{ActualPub, _}, _}, Channel, Payload} ->
  910:                 ok
  911:         after 5000 ->
  912:             ct:fail(authenticated_coalesced_payload_not_delivered)
  913:         end,
  914:         receive
  915:             {quod_message, _, Channel, Payload} ->
  916:                 ct:fail(authenticated_coalesced_payload_duplicated)
  917:         after 100 ->
  918:             ok
  919:         end,
  920:         _ = catch quic:close(Conn, normal),
  921:         ok
  922:     after
  923:         true = quod_reg:unsubscribe({channel, Channel})
  924:     end.
  925: 
  926: %% no_learn is connection-wide and monotone. A later authenticated stream
  927: %% cannot flip it back to learn and overwrite the shared address cache.
  928: no_learn_is_monotone_across_streams(_Config) ->
  929:     {ActualPub, _} = ActualKeyPair = quod_identity:generate(),
  930:     ActualCert = quod_identity:mint_cert(ActualKeyPair),
  931:     ActualKey = quod_identity:key_term(ActualKeyPair),
  932:     Existing = {"127.0.0.1", 24450},
  933:     FirstChannel = <<"no-learn-latch">>,
  934:     SecondChannel = <<"learn-cannot-reenable">>,
  935:     true = quod_reg:subscribe({channel, FirstChannel}),
  936:     true = quod_reg:subscribe({channel, SecondChannel}),
  937:     ok = quod_quic:learn(ActualPub, Existing),
  938:     try
  939:         {ok, Conn} = quic:connect(
  940:                        element(1, ?SELF), element(2, ?SELF),
  941:                        #{verify => false, cert => ActualCert, key => ActualKey,
  942:                          alpn => [<<"quod">>]}, self()),
  943:         receive
  944:             {quic, Conn, {connected, _}} -> ok
  945:         after 5000 -> ct:fail(no_monotone_policy_connection)
  946:         end,
  947:         send_raw_header_payload(
  948:           Conn, ActualPub, {"127.0.0.1", 24451},
  949:           FirstChannel, no_learn, <<"latch">>),
  950:         receive
  951:             {quod_message, {{ActualPub, _}, _},
  952:              FirstChannel, <<"latch">>} -> ok
  953:         after 5000 -> ct:fail(no_no_learn_latch_message)
  954:         end,
  955:         {ok, Existing} = quod_quic:resolve(ActualPub),
  956:         send_raw_header_payload(
  957:           Conn, ActualPub, {"127.0.0.1", 24452},
  958:           SecondChannel, learn, <<"cannot-reenable">>),
  959:         receive
  960:             {quod_message, {{ActualPub, _}, _},
  961:              SecondChannel, <<"cannot-reenable">>} -> ok
  962:         after 5000 -> ct:fail(no_second_authenticated_message)
  963:         end,
  964:         {ok, Existing} = quod_quic:resolve(ActualPub),
  965:         _ = catch quic:close(Conn, normal),
  966:         ok
  967:     after
  968:         true = quod_reg:unsubscribe({channel, FirstChannel}),
  969:         true = quod_reg:unsubscribe({channel, SecondChannel})
  970:     end.
  971: 
  972: send_raw_header_payload(Conn, Pubkey, Endpoint, Channel, Policy, Payload) ->
  973:     {ok, Sid} = quic:open_stream(Conn),
  974:     Header = quod_link:header({Pubkey, Endpoint}, Channel, Policy),
  975:     quic:send_data(
  976:       Conn, Sid,
  977:       <<Header/binary, (quod_link:frame(Payload))/binary>>, false).
  978: 
  979: %% A PUBKEY target (the production id form) is resolved to an endpoint via a learned hint,
  980: %% then dialed — the resolver path end to end through the real transport. (We map a fresh
  981: %% pubkey to our own loopback listener so the dial connects.)
  982: resolve_and_dial_by_pubkey(Config) ->
  983:     PK = ?config(self_pubkey, Config),
  984:     ok = quod_quic:learn(PK, ?SELF),
  985:     ok = quod_quic:open_link(PK, <<"chan-pk">>),
  986:     receive
  987:         {link_up, PK, <<"chan-pk">>, LinkPid} when is_pid(LinkPid) -> ok
  988:     after 5000 -> ct:fail(no_link_up_by_pubkey)
  989:     end.
  990: 
  991: %% An ordinary public-key target is still an identity claim, not merely a
  992: %% cache lookup. Resolving that key to a live endpoint whose certificate
  993: %% carries another key must fail before any stream becomes usable.
  994: ordinary_pubkey_dial_rejects_wrong_cert(Config) ->
  995:     Actual = ?config(self_pubkey, Config),
  996:     Expected = crypto:strong_rand_bytes(32),
  997:     true = Expected =/= Actual,
  998:     ok = quod_quic:learn(Expected, ?SELF),
  999:     Channel = <<"chan-ordinary-wrong-cert">>,
 1000:     ok = quod_quic:open_link(Expected, Channel),
 1001:     receive
 1002:         {link_error, Expected, Channel} -> ok;
 1003:         {link_up, Expected, Channel, _} ->
 1004:             ct:fail(ordinary_pubkey_dial_accepted_wrong_cert)
 1005:     after 5000 ->
 1006:         ct:fail(no_ordinary_pubkey_mismatch_result)
 1007:     end.
 1008: 
 1009: %% Every connection owner is linked to the transport authority. This makes a
 1010: %% transport restart one ownership boundary: old connections and their streams
 1011: %% cannot survive as an untracked duplicate generation.
 1012: connection_is_owned_by_transport(_Config) ->
 1013:     Channel = <<"chan-owned-connection">>,
 1014:     ok = quod_quic:open_link(?SELF, Channel),
 1015:     Link =
 1016:         receive
 1017:             {link_up, ?SELF, Channel, Pid} -> Pid
 1018:         after 5000 ->
 1019:             ct:fail(no_owned_link)
 1020:         end,
 1021:     {links, [ConnOwner]} = process_info(Link, links),
 1022:     Authority = quod_reg:where({transport, node}),
 1023:     {links, OwnerLinks} = process_info(ConnOwner, links),
 1024:     true = lists:member(Authority, OwnerLinks).
 1025: 
 1026: %% The connection authority reports authenticated host contact, not stream
 1027: %% readiness. A stream reset must not remove a live connection. A terminal
 1028: %% notice for an old owner must not remove its replacement.
 1029: authenticated_peer_connections(Config) ->
 1030:     Pub = ?config(self_pubkey, Config),
 1031:     Unknown = crypto:strong_rand_bytes(32),
 1032:     Authority = quod_reg:where({transport, node}),
 1033:     true = quod_reg:subscribe({peer_connections, Pub}),
 1034:     try
 1035:         {_, []} = peer_snapshot(Authority, Unknown),
 1036:         Channel = <<"peer-connection-observation">>,
 1037:         Ref = quod_quic:open_link_pinned(Pub, ?SELF, Channel),
 1038:         Link = receive
 1039:             {link_up, Ref, Pub, Channel, Pid} -> Pid
 1040:         after 5000 -> ct:fail(no_observed_link)
 1041:         end,
 1042:         {links, [Conn]} = process_info(Link, links),
 1043:         {Before, Connections} = peer_snapshot(Authority, Pub),
 1044:         true = lists:member(Conn, Connections),
 1045:         LinkMonitor = monitor(process, Link),
 1046:         ok = quod_conn:reset_inbound_channel(Channel),
 1047:         receive
 1048:             {'DOWN', LinkMonitor, process, Link, _} -> ok
 1049:         after 5000 -> ct:fail(stream_not_reset)
 1050:         end,
 1051:         {Before, Connections} = peer_snapshot(Authority, Pub),
 1052:         exit(Conn, kill),
 1053:         Removed = await_connection_removed(Authority, Pub, Conn, Before),
 1054:         Ref2 = quod_quic:open_link_pinned(Pub, ?SELF, Channel),
 1055:         Link2 = receive
 1056:             {link_up, Ref2, Pub, Channel, Pid2} -> Pid2
 1057:         after 5000 -> ct:fail(no_replacement_link)
 1058:         end,
 1059:         {links, [Replacement]} = process_info(Link2, links),
 1060:         true = Replacement =/= Conn,
 1061:         {After, NewConnections} = peer_snapshot(Authority, Pub),
 1062:         true = After > Removed,
 1063:         true = lists:member(Replacement, NewConnections),
 1064:         Authority ! {conn_terminal, Conn, make_ref()},
 1065:         {After, NewConnections} = peer_snapshot(Authority, Pub)
 1066:     after
 1067:         true = quod_reg:unsubscribe({peer_connections, Pub})
 1068:     end.
 1069: 
 1070: inbound_owner_death_closes_wire_connection(_Config) ->
 1071:     Channel = <<"inbound-owner-death">>,
 1072:     true = quod_reg:subscribe({channel, Channel}),
 1073:     ok = quod_quic:open_link(?SELF, Channel),
 1074:     Out = receive {link_up, ?SELF, Channel, L} -> L
 1075:           after 5000 -> ct:fail(no_owner_death_link) end,
 1076:     OutMonitor = monitor(process, Out),
 1077:     try
 1078:         ok = quod_link:send(Out, <<"owner-evidence">>),
 1079:         In = receive {quod_message, {_, L0}, Channel, <<"owner-evidence">>} -> L0
 1080:              after 5000 -> ct:fail(no_owner_death_receipt) end,
 1081:         {links, [InboundOwner]} = process_info(In, links),
 1082:         {ok, {Wire, _}} = quod_link:test_transport(In),
 1083:         Monitor = monitor(process, Wire),
 1084:         exit(InboundOwner, kill),
 1085:         receive {'DOWN', OutMonitor, process, Out, _} -> ok
 1086:         after 5000 -> ct:fail(orphaned_inbound_connection_kept_peer_alive) end,
 1087:         receive {'DOWN', Monitor, process, Wire, _} -> ok
 1088:         after 5000 -> ct:fail(orphaned_inbound_wire_not_closed) end,
 1089:         %% Replacement uses the ordinary pool after the old wire is retired.
 1090:         ok = quod_quic:open_link(?SELF, Channel),
 1091:         receive {link_up, ?SELF, Channel, Next} when Next =/= Out -> ok
 1092:         after 5000 -> ct:fail(no_link_after_inbound_owner_death) end
 1093:     after
 1094:         demonitor(OutMonitor, [flush]),
 1095:         quod_reg:unsubscribe({channel, Channel})
 1096:     end.
 1097: 
 1098: connection_confirmation_without_stream(Config) ->
 1099:     Authority = quod_reg:where({transport, node}),
 1100:     Key = ?config(self_pubkey, Config),
 1101:     Unknown = crypto:strong_rand_bytes(32),
 1102:     Deadline = quod_time:mono_ms() + 5000,
 1103:     Missing = quod_quic:confirm_peer(Authority, Unknown, undefined, Deadline),
 1104:     {undefined, {unknown, invalid_endpoint}} = confirmation(Authority, Missing, Unknown),
 1105:     %% A poisoned address hint must not redirect an exact-endpoint probe.
 1106:     ok = quod_quic:learn(Key, {"127.0.0.1", 9}),
 1107:     Expired = quod_quic:confirm_peer(Authority, Key, ?SELF, quod_time:mono_ms() - 1),
 1108:     {undefined, {unknown, deadline_exceeded}} = confirmation(Authority, Expired, Key),
 1109:     First = quod_quic:confirm_peer(Authority, Key, ?SELF, Deadline),
 1110:     {Conn, authenticated} = confirmation(Authority, First, Key),
 1111:     Second = quod_quic:confirm_peer(Authority, Key, ?SELF, Deadline),
 1112:     {Conn, authenticated} = confirmation(Authority, Second, Key),
 1113:     {_, Connections} = peer_snapshot(Authority, Key),
 1114:     true = lists:member(Conn, Connections),
 1115:     %% A known address presenting another key is a terminal confirmation
 1116:     %% failure, distinguishable from a missing address. No stream is needed.
 1117:     ok = quod_quic:learn(Unknown, ?SELF),
 1118:     Wrong = quod_quic:confirm_peer(Authority, Unknown, ?SELF, Deadline),
 1119:     {Rejected, {failed, {peer_identity, _}}} = confirmation(Authority, Wrong, Unknown),
 1120:     true = is_pid(Rejected),
 1121:     {_, []} = peer_snapshot(Authority, Unknown),
 1122:     %% Retiring the exact outbound generation forces the next confirmation
 1123:     %% through a fresh handshake in the same pinned pool.
 1124:     true = quod_reg:subscribe({peer_connections, Key}),
 1125:     try
 1126:         {Revision, _} = peer_snapshot(Authority, Key),
 1127:         exit(Conn, kill),
 1128:         _ = await_connection_removed(Authority, Key, Conn, Revision),
 1129:         Fresh = quod_quic:confirm_peer(Authority, Key, ?SELF, quod_time:mono_ms() + 5000),
 1130:         {Replacement, authenticated} = confirmation(Authority, Fresh, Key),
 1131:         true = Replacement =/= Conn
 1132:     after quod_reg:unsubscribe({peer_connections, Key}) end.
 1133: 
 1134: shared_peer_loss_confirmation(Config) ->
 1135:     Since = quod_time:mono_ms(),
 1136:     Authority = quod_reg:where({transport, node}),
 1137:     Key = ?config(self_pubkey, Config),
 1138:     Unknown = crypto:strong_rand_bytes(32),
 1139:     NodeRef = install_loss_contact(Key, ?SELF, 1),
 1140:     UnknownRef = install_loss_contact(Unknown, ?SELF, 1),
 1141:     {ok, UnknownContact} = quod_directory:node_transport_route(UnknownRef),
 1142:     NoInterest = quod_quic:confirm_peer_loss(Authority, UnknownContact, Since),
 1143:     {none, {unknown, not_subscribed}} = loss_snapshot(Authority, NoInterest, Unknown),
 1144:     true = quod_reg:subscribe({peer_loss, Unknown}),
 1145:     true = quod_reg:subscribe({peer_loss, Key}),
 1146:     true = quod_reg:subscribe({peer_connections, Key}),
 1147:     {ok, Blackhole} = gen_udp:open(0, [binary, {active, false}]),
 1148:     {ok, Port} = inet:port(Blackhole),
 1149:     try
 1150:         Missing = quod_quic:confirm_peer_loss(Authority, unknown, Since),
 1151:         receive {Missing, {unknown, route_unavailable}} -> ok
 1152:         after 1000 -> ct:fail(missing_route_became_failure) end,
 1153:         ok = quod_quic:learn(Key, ?SELF),
 1154:         Contact = quod_quic:confirm_peer(Authority, Key, ?SELF, quod_time:mono_ms() + 5000),
 1155:         {_, authenticated} = confirmation(Authority, Contact, Key),
 1156:         {Revision, Connections} = peer_snapshot(Authority, Key),
 1157:         [_ | _] = Connections,
 1158:         lists:foreach(fun(Pid) -> exit(Pid, kill) end, Connections),
 1159:         await_no_connections(Authority, Key, Revision),
 1160:         NodeRef = install_loss_contact(Key, {"127.0.0.1", Port}, 2),
 1161:         {ok, ContactData} = quod_directory:node_transport_route(NodeRef),
 1162:         %% The hint points at a healthy listener. Recovery must still probe the
 1163:         %% exact certified endpoint, which is a silent UDP socket in this test.
 1164:         ok = quod_quic:learn(Key, ?SELF),
 1165:         First = quod_quic:confirm_peer_loss(Authority, ContactData, Since),
 1166:         {Episode, waiting} = loss_snapshot(Authority, First, Key),
 1167:         Parent = self(),
 1168:         {Other, OtherMonitor} = spawn_monitor(fun() ->
 1169:             true = quod_reg:subscribe({peer_loss, Key}),
 1170:             Second = quod_quic:confirm_peer_loss(Authority, ContactData, Since),
 1171:             Snapshot = loss_snapshot(Authority, Second, Key),
 1172:             Parent ! {shared_loss_snapshot, self(), Snapshot},
 1173:             receive
 1174:                 Notice = {peer_loss, Authority, Key, Episode, _, _} ->
 1175:                     Parent ! {shared_loss_result, self(), Notice}
 1176:             after 8000 -> exit(no_shared_loss_notice)
 1177:             end
 1178:         end),
 1179:         receive {shared_loss_snapshot, Other, {Episode, waiting}} -> ok
 1180:         after 5000 -> ct:fail(no_shared_snapshot) end,
 1181:         %% Receipt of an actual Initial datagram proves the grace timer led
 1182:         %% to a real confirmation dial, rather than interpreting no route.
 1183:         {ok, {_, _, _Packet}} = gen_udp:recv(Blackhole, 0, 3000),
 1184:         await_loss(Authority, Key, Episode, suspected_unreachable),
 1185:         receive
 1186:             {shared_loss_result, Other,
 1187:              {peer_loss, Authority, Key, Episode, suspected_unreachable, _}} -> ok
 1188:         after 5000 -> ct:fail(no_shared_result) end,
 1189:         receive {'DOWN', OtherMonitor, process, Other, normal} -> ok
 1190:         after 5000 -> ct:fail(shared_consumer_not_done) end,
 1191:         Third = quod_quic:confirm_peer_loss(Authority, ContactData, Since),
 1192:         {Episode, suspected_unreachable} = loss_snapshot(Authority, Third, Key),
 1193:         %% A genuine new recovery dependency cannot consume cached old evidence.
 1194:         Fresh = quod_quic:confirm_peer_loss(Authority, ContactData, quod_time:mono_ms()),
 1195:         {FreshEpisode, waiting} = loss_snapshot(Authority, Fresh, Key),
 1196:         true = FreshEpisode =/= Episode,
 1197:         ok = quod_quic:learn(Key, ?SELF),
 1198:         Reconnect = quod_quic:confirm_peer(Authority, Key, ?SELF, quod_time:mono_ms() + 5000),
 1199:         {_, authenticated} = confirmation(Authority, Reconnect, Key),
 1200:         %% Authenticating the same key at a different endpoint does not turn
 1201:         %% the certified endpoint's still-failing probe into positive evidence.
 1202:         await_loss(Authority, Key, FreshEpisode, suspected_unreachable),
 1203:         Healthy = quod_quic:confirm_peer_loss(Authority, ContactData, Since),
 1204:         {FreshEpisode, suspected_unreachable} = loss_snapshot(Authority, Healthy, Key),
 1205:         {NextRevision, NextConnections} = peer_snapshot(Authority, Key),
 1206:         lists:foreach(fun(Pid) -> exit(Pid, kill) end, NextConnections),
 1207:         await_no_connections(Authority, Key, NextRevision),
 1208:         NodeRef = install_loss_contact(Key, ?SELF, 3),
 1209:         {ok, NextContactData} = quod_directory:node_transport_route(NodeRef),
 1210:         NextLoss = quod_quic:confirm_peer_loss(Authority, NextContactData, Since),
 1211:         {NextEpisode, waiting} = loss_snapshot(Authority, NextLoss, Key),
 1212:         true = NextEpisode =/= Episode,
 1213:         FastReconnect = quod_quic:confirm_peer(Authority, Key, ?SELF, quod_time:mono_ms() + 5000),
 1214:         {_, authenticated} = confirmation(Authority, FastReconnect, Key),
 1215:         await_loss(Authority, Key, NextEpisode, reachable),
 1216:         %% Cross the actual grace boundary after reconnection: its cancelled
 1217:         %% timer must not publish a late failure for this episode.
 1218:         Control = erlang:start_timer(1200, self(), grace_cancellation_control),
 1219:         receive
 1220:             {peer_loss, Authority, Key, NextEpisode, Unexpected, _} ->
 1221:                 ct:fail({late_cancelled_episode, Unexpected});
 1222:             {timeout, Control, grace_cancellation_control} -> ok
 1223:         after 3000 -> ct:fail(no_grace_control) end
 1224:     after
 1225:         gen_udp:close(Blackhole),
 1226:         quod_reg:unsubscribe({peer_loss, Unknown}),
 1227:         quod_reg:unsubscribe({peer_loss, Key}),
 1228:         quod_reg:unsubscribe({peer_connections, Key}),
 1229:         quod_quic:learn(Key, ?SELF)
 1230:     end.
 1231: 
 1232: inconclusive_loss_confirmation_is_reobserved(_Config) ->
 1233:     Authority = quod_reg:where({transport, node}),
 1234:     {Key, _} = Right = quod_identity:generate(),
 1235:     Wrong = quod_identity:generate(),
 1236:     {ok, Socket} = gen_udp:open(0),
 1237:     {ok, Port} = inet:port(Socket), ok = gen_udp:close(Socket),
 1238:     Endpoint = {"127.0.0.1", Port}, Parent = self(),
 1239:     Start = fun(Pair) -> quic:start_server(inconclusive_probe, Port,
 1240:         #{cert => quod_identity:mint_cert(Pair), key => quod_identity:key_term(Pair),
 1241:           verify => true, alpn => [<<"quod">>],
 1242:           connection_handler => fun(_) -> {ok, Parent} end}) end,
 1243:     {ok, _} = Start(Wrong),
 1244:     H = install_loss_contact(Key, Endpoint, 1),
 1245:     {ok, Contact} = quod_directory:node_transport_route(H),
 1246:     true = quod_reg:subscribe({peer_loss, Key}),
 1247:     try
 1248:         Ref = quod_quic:confirm_peer_loss(Authority, Contact, quod_time:mono_ms()),
 1249:         {Episode, waiting} = loss_snapshot(Authority, Ref, Key),
 1250:         receive {peer_loss, Authority, Key, Episode, {unknown, {peer_identity, _}}, _} -> ok
 1251:         after 8000 -> ct:fail(identity_rejection_was_not_unknown) end,
 1252:         ok = quic:stop_server(inconclusive_probe),
 1253:         %% stop_server joins the listener shutdown; its registry monitor is
 1254:         %% asynchronous. Complete named cleanup before reusing that name.
 1255:         ok = quic_server_registry:unregister(inconclusive_probe),
 1256:         {ok, _} = Start(Right),
 1257:         %% No new route/assignment edge and no write outcome: the same shared
 1258:         %% physical detector must continue after an inconclusive attempt.
 1259:         receive {peer_loss, Authority, Key, FreshEpisode, reachable, At}
 1260:                   when FreshEpisode =/= Episode, is_integer(At) -> ok
 1261:         after 40000 -> ct:fail(inconclusive_episode_stopped_detection) end
 1262:     after
 1263:         quod_reg:unsubscribe({peer_loss, Key}),
 1264:         quic:stop_server(inconclusive_probe)
 1265:     end.
 1266: 
 1267: terminal_confirmation_preserves_observation_time(Config) ->
 1268:     {ok, Blackhole} = gen_udp:open(0, [binary, {active, false}]),
 1269:     {ok, Port} = inet:port(Blackhole),
 1270:     Parent = self(), Key = crypto:strong_rand_bytes(32),
 1271:     {Owner, OwnerMonitor} = spawn_monitor(fun() ->
 1272:         process_flag(trap_exit, true),
 1273:         receive {conn_terminal, C, R} ->
 1274:             Parent ! {terminal_waiting, C},
 1275:             receive release -> C ! {conn_terminal_ack, self(), R} end
 1276:         end
 1277:     end),
 1278:     Conn = quod_conn:start_outbound("127.0.0.1", Port, Key,
 1279:         {?config(self_pubkey, Config), ?SELF}, [<<"quod">>],
 1280:         ?config(cert_der, Config), ?config(key_term, Config),
 1281:         #{expected_peer => Key, learn_hint => no_learn}, Owner),
 1282:     Monitor = monitor(process, Conn),
 1283:     try
 1284:         First = make_ref(),
 1285:         Conn ! {confirm_peer, self(), First, Key, quod_time:mono_ms() + 8000},
 1286:         {ok, {_, _, _}} = gen_udp:recv(Blackhole, 0, 3000),
 1287:         receive {terminal_waiting, Conn} -> ok
 1288:         after 8000 -> ct:fail(no_terminal_failure) end,
 1289:         {Result, Observation = {Mono, Wall}} = receive
 1290:             {peer_confirmation, Owner, First, Key, Conn, {failed, _} = R, O} -> {R, O}
 1291:         after 1000 -> ct:fail(no_first_terminal_confirmation) end,
 1292:         true = is_integer(Wall),
 1293:         %% Cross the captured observation time using an absolute control timer;
 1294:         %% readiness is established by the real terminal-owner receipt above.
 1295:         Control = erlang:start_timer(Mono + 2, self(), after_observation, [{abs, true}]),
 1296:         receive {timeout, Control, after_observation} -> ok
 1297:         after 1000 -> ct:fail(observation_control_missing) end,
 1298:         Second = make_ref(),
 1299:         Conn ! {confirm_peer, self(), Second, Key, quod_time:mono_ms() + 1000},
 1300:         receive {peer_confirmation, Owner, Second, Key, Conn, Result, Observation} -> ok
 1301:         after 1000 -> ct:fail(terminal_reply_minted_fresh_evidence) end,
 1302:         %% Confirmation must not replace the existing terminal link responder.
 1303:         %% Until the authority removes this pid, a queued opener still gets its
 1304:         %% definitive error instead of disappearing in the terminal mailbox.
 1305:         quod_conn:open_link(Conn, <<"terminal-opener">>, self()),
 1306:         receive {link_error, Key, <<"terminal-opener">>} -> ok
 1307:         after 1000 -> ct:fail(terminal_opener_was_lost) end,
 1308:         Owner ! release,
 1309:         receive {'DOWN', Monitor, process, Conn, {shutdown, _}} -> ok
 1310:         after 1000 -> ct:fail(terminal_connection_not_joined) end,
 1311:         receive {'DOWN', OwnerMonitor, process, Owner, normal} -> ok
 1312:         after 1000 -> ct:fail(terminal_owner_not_joined) end
 1313:     after
 1314:         exit(Conn, kill), exit(Owner, kill),
 1315:         demonitor(Monitor, [flush]), demonitor(OwnerMonitor, [flush]),
 1316:         gen_udp:close(Blackhole)
 1317:     end.
 1318: 
 1319: observer_confirmation_deadline_releases_pending(Config) ->
 1320:     SelfKey = ?config(self_pubkey, Config),
 1321:     {Peer, Key, Endpoint} = start_observed_peer(Config),
 1322:     Saved = application:get_env(quod, node_actor_principal),
 1323:     Observer = {agent_instance_ref, <<"observer:deadline">>, <<94:256>>, physical_node},
 1324:     {ok, Blob} = quod_wire_term:encode_canonical(Observer),
 1325:     application:set_env(quod, node_actor_principal, {agent, Blob}),
 1326:     H = install_loss_contact(Key, Endpoint, 1),
 1327:     Transport = quod_reg:where({transport, node}),
 1328:     ok = sys:suspend(Transport),
 1329:     Parent = self(),
 1330:     {Owner, Monitor} = spawn_monitor(fun() ->
 1331:         S0 = quod_agent_observer:new(SelfKey),
 1332:         {ok, S1} = quod_agent_observer:project(all, [{watch, actor, H, 1, none}], S0),
 1333:         observer_test_loop(S1, Parent, false)
 1334:     end),
 1335:     try
 1336:         %% Only the request's own absolute deadline can clear pending while
 1337:         %% the real transport owner is held and cannot reply or publish edges.
 1338:         receive {observer_baseline, Owner, false, 1} -> ok
 1339:         after 7000 -> ct:fail(observer_request_never_expired) end,
 1340:         ok = sys:resume(Transport),
 1341:         {error, unknown_request} = gen_server:call(Transport, deadline_barrier),
 1342:         Round = crypto:strong_rand_bytes(32),
 1343:         Owner ! {project_watches, [{watch, actor, H, 1, {current, Round}}]},
 1344:         receive {observer_event, Owner,
 1345:                  {agent_host_observed, SelfKey, Observer, actor, H, 1, {current, Round},
 1346:                   Round, _, reachable, _, _}} -> ok
 1347:         after 6000 -> ct:fail(deadline_left_watch_wedged) end,
 1348:         receive {observer_event, Owner, _} -> ct:fail(deadline_reported_as_failure)
 1349:         after 0 -> ok end
 1350:     after
 1351:         catch sys:resume(Transport), Owner ! stop,
 1352:         receive {'DOWN', Monitor, process, Owner, normal} -> ok
 1353:         after 3000 -> exit(Owner, kill) end,
 1354:         catch quod_agent_peer:stop(Peer),
 1355:         case Saved of
 1356:             undefined -> application:unset_env(quod, node_actor_principal);
 1357:             {ok, Value} -> application:set_env(quod, node_actor_principal, Value)
 1358:         end
 1359:     end.
 1360: 
 1361: recovery_round_reconfirms_existing_connection(Config) ->
 1362:     SelfKey = ?config(self_pubkey, Config),
 1363:     {Peer, Key, Endpoint} = start_observed_peer(Config),
 1364:     Saved = application:get_env(quod, node_actor_principal),
 1365:     Observer = {agent_instance_ref, <<"observer:round">>, <<93:256>>, physical_node},
 1366:     {ok, ObserverBlob} = quod_wire_term:encode_canonical(Observer),
 1367:     application:set_env(quod, node_actor_principal, {agent, ObserverBlob}),
 1368:     H = install_loss_contact(Key, Endpoint, 1),
 1369:     Parent = self(),
 1370:     {Owner, Monitor} = spawn_monitor(fun() ->
 1371:         S0 = quod_agent_observer:new(SelfKey),
 1372:         {ok, S1} = quod_agent_observer:project(all, [{watch, actor, H, 1, none}], S0),
 1373:         observer_test_loop(S1, Parent, false)
 1374:     end),
 1375:     try
 1376:         receive {observer_baseline, Owner, true, 1} -> ok
 1377:         after 6000 -> ct:fail(round_observer_not_ready) end,
 1378:         Transport = quod_reg:where({transport, node}),
 1379:         Snapshot = quod_quic:peer_connections(Transport, Key),
 1380:         {Rev, Pids} = receive {Snapshot, {peer_connections, Transport, R, Key, Ps}} -> {R, Ps}
 1381:                      after 3000 -> ct:fail(no_connection_snapshot) end,
 1382:         [_, _] = [begin
 1383:             Round = crypto:strong_rand_bytes(32),
 1384:             Owner ! {project_watches, [{watch, actor, H, 1, {current, Round}}]},
 1385:             receive
 1386:                 {observer_event, Owner,
 1387:                  {agent_host_observed, SelfKey, Observer, actor, H, 1, {current, Round},
 1388:                   Round, _, reachable, At, Expiry}} -> 60000 = Expiry - At
 1389:             after 6000 -> ct:fail({new_round_missing_reachable_report, N}) end,
 1390:             Check = quod_quic:peer_connections(Transport, Key),
 1391:             receive {Check, {peer_connections, Transport, Rev, Key, Pids}} -> ok
 1392:             after 3000 -> ct:fail(connection_changed_during_round_confirmation) end
 1393:         end || N <- [1, 2]],
 1394:         {OtherPeer, OtherKey, OtherEndpoint} = quod_agent_peer:start(
 1395:           filename:join(?config(priv_dir, Config), "unrelated-peer")),
 1396:         try
 1397:             Other = quod_quic:confirm_peer(Transport, OtherKey, OtherEndpoint,
 1398:                                            quod_time:mono_ms() + 5000),
 1399:             {_, authenticated} = confirmation(Transport, Other, OtherKey),
 1400:             Barrier = make_ref(),
 1401:             Owner ! {observer_barrier, self(), Barrier},
 1402:             receive {observer_barrier, Barrier} -> ok after 1000 -> ct:fail(no_observer_barrier) end,
 1403:             flush_observer_snapshots(Owner),
 1404:             {ok, #{expiry := Expiry}} = quod_directory:node_transport_route(H),
 1405:             ok = quod_directory:expire(Expiry),
 1406:             %% The retained contact's completed episode is unchanged. The
 1407:             %% directory edge must not mint another positive observation.
 1408:             receive {observer_loss_handled, Owner, Key, reachable, 0} -> ok
 1409:             after 3000 -> ct:fail(no_post_expiry_observation_snapshot) end,
 1410:             receive {observer_event, Owner, _} -> ct:fail(unrelated_peer_caused_report)
 1411:             after 0 -> ok end
 1412:         after quod_agent_peer:stop(OtherPeer) end
 1413:     after
 1414:         Owner ! stop,
 1415:         receive {'DOWN', Monitor, process, Owner, normal} -> ok
 1416:         after 3000 -> exit(Owner, kill) end,
 1417:         ok = peer:call(Peer, application, stop, [quod]),
 1418:         ok = peer:call(Peer, application, stop, [quic]),
 1419:         catch peer:stop(Peer),
 1420:         case Saved of
 1421:             undefined -> application:unset_env(quod, node_actor_principal);
 1422:             {ok, Value} -> application:set_env(quod, node_actor_principal, Value)
 1423:         end
 1424:     end.
 1425: 
 1426: ontology_observer_shares_physical_failure(Config) ->
 1427:     SelfKey = ?config(self_pubkey, Config),
 1428:     {Peer, Key, Endpoint} = start_observed_peer(Config),
 1429:     Saved = application:get_env(quod, node_actor_principal),
 1430:     Observer = {agent_instance_ref, <<"observer:node">>, <<92:256>>, physical_node},
 1431:     {ok, ObserverBlob} = quod_wire_term:encode_canonical(Observer),
 1432:     application:set_env(quod, node_actor_principal, {agent, ObserverBlob}),
 1433:     H = install_loss_contact(Key, Endpoint, 1),
 1434:     {ok, #{expiry := LeaseExpiry} = Certified} = quod_directory:node_transport_route(H),
 1435:     Rows = [{watch, first, H, 1, none}, {watch, second, H, 1, none}],
 1436:     Parent = self(),
 1437:     Start = fun() -> spawn_monitor(fun() ->
 1438:         S0 = quod_agent_observer:new(SelfKey),
 1439:         {ok, S1} = quod_agent_observer:project(all, Rows, S0),
 1440:         self() ! observer_ready_check,
 1441:         observer_test_loop(S1, Parent, false)
 1442:     end) end,
 1443:     {Owner, Monitor} = Start(),
 1444:     try
 1445:         receive {observer_baseline, Owner, true, 1} -> ok
 1446:         after 6000 -> ct:fail(observer_never_established_coverage) end,
 1447:         %% Lease expiry removes routing, not an already authenticated monitor.
 1448:         ok = quod_directory:expire(LeaseExpiry),
 1449:         unknown = quod_directory:node_transport_route(H),
 1450:         true = quod_directory:node_contact_current(Certified),
 1451:         %% Join the actual listener/connection owners before reusing their
 1452:         %% UDP port; closing peer's stdio controller alone does not join the VM.
 1453:         ok = peer:call(Peer, application, stop, [quod]),
 1454:         ok = peer:call(Peer, application, stop, [quic]),
 1455:         ok = peer:stop(Peer),
 1456:         {ok, Blackhole} = gen_udp:open(element(2, Endpoint), [binary, {active, false}]),
 1457:         try
 1458:             FirstCid = next_initial(Blackhole, none, quod_time:mono_ms() + 5000),
 1459:             First = receive {observer_event, Owner, E1} -> E1
 1460:                     after 8000 -> ct:fail(first_observation_missing) end,
 1461:             Second = receive {observer_event, Owner, E2} -> E2
 1462:                      after 1000 -> ct:fail(second_observation_missing) end,
 1463:             {agent_host_observed, SelfKey, Observer, _, H, 1, none, Episode, Episode,
 1464:              suspected_unreachable, At, Expiry} = First,
 1465:             {agent_host_observed, SelfKey, Observer, _, H, 1, none, Episode, Episode,
 1466:              suspected_unreachable, At, Expiry} = Second,
 1467:             true = byte_size(Episode) =:= 32,
 1468:             60000 = Expiry - At,
 1469:             [first, second] = lists:sort([element(4, First), element(4, Second)]),
 1470:             %% A replacement ontology consumer reuses the transport's exact
 1471:             %% retained contact, but requires a completion after its dependency.
 1472:             {Cold, ColdMonitor} = Start(),
 1473:             %% The changed dependency, independent of a write outcome, drives
 1474:             %% another real probe shared with the existing consumer.
 1475:             Fresh = receive {observer_event, Owner, E3} -> E3
 1476:                     after 8000 -> ct:fail(fresh_physical_observation_missing) end,
 1477:             {agent_host_observed, SelfKey, Observer, _, H, 1, none, NextEpisode, NextEpisode,
 1478:              suspected_unreachable, NextAt, _} = Fresh,
