 1479:             true = NextEpisode =/= Episode,
 1480:             true = NextAt > At,
 1481:             _ = next_initial(Blackhole, FirstCid, quod_time:mono_ms() + 1000),
 1482:             receive {observer_event, Owner,
 1483:                      {agent_host_observed, SelfKey, Observer, _, H, 1, none,
 1484:                       NextEpisode, NextEpisode, suspected_unreachable, NextAt, _}} -> ok
 1485:             after 1000 -> ct:fail(fresh_observation_not_shared) end,
 1486:             [_, _] = [receive {observer_event, Cold,
 1487:                     {agent_host_observed, SelfKey, Observer, _, H, 1, none,
 1488:                      NextEpisode, NextEpisode, suspected_unreachable, NextAt, _}} -> ok
 1489:                       after 1000 -> ct:fail(restarted_observer_lost_contact) end || _ <- [1,2]],
 1490:             Cold ! stop,
 1491:             receive {'DOWN', ColdMonitor, process, Cold, normal} -> ok
 1492:             after 3000 -> ct:fail(cold_observer_not_stopped) end,
 1493:             %% Explicit newer contact invalidates the retained reference.
 1494:             H = install_loss_contact(Key, Endpoint, 2),
 1495:             false = quod_directory:node_contact_current(Certified)
 1496:         after gen_udp:close(Blackhole) end
 1497:     after
 1498:         Owner ! stop,
 1499:         receive {'DOWN', Monitor, process, Owner, _} -> ok
 1500:         after 3000 -> exit(Owner, kill) end,
 1501:         catch peer:stop(Peer),
 1502:         case Saved of
 1503:             undefined -> application:unset_env(quod, node_actor_principal);
 1504:             {ok, Value} -> application:set_env(quod, node_actor_principal, Value)
 1505:         end
 1506:     end.
 1507: 
 1508: %% Header protection leaves the long-header form and packet type exposed.
 1509: %% Old 1-RTT packets can arrive after the peer has released its UDP port.
 1510: initial_destination(<<1:1, 1:1, 0:2, _:4, 1:32,
 1511:                       Length:8, Cid:Length/binary, _/binary>>) -> {initial, Cid};
 1512: initial_destination(_) -> other.
 1513: 
 1514: next_initial(Socket, Previous, Deadline) ->
 1515:     case gen_udp:recv(Socket, 0, max(0, Deadline - quod_time:mono_ms())) of
 1516:         {ok, {_, _, Packet}} ->
 1517:             case initial_destination(Packet) of
 1518:                 {initial, Cid} when Cid =/= Previous -> Cid;
 1519:                 _ -> next_initial(Socket, Previous, Deadline)
 1520:             end;
 1521:         {error, Reason} -> ct:fail({new_observation_without_new_initial, Reason})
 1522:     end.
 1523: 
 1524: start_observed_peer(Config) ->
 1525:     quod_agent_peer:start(filename:join(?config(priv_dir, Config), "observed-peer")).
 1526: 
 1527: observer_test_loop(S, Parent, Announced) ->
 1528:     receive
 1529:         stop -> quod_agent_observer:stop(S);
 1530:         {observer_barrier, From, Tag} ->
 1531:             From ! {observer_barrier, Tag},
 1532:             observer_test_loop(S, Parent, Announced);
 1533:         {project_watches, Rows} ->
 1534:             {ok, Next} = quod_agent_observer:project(all, Rows, S),
 1535:             observer_test_loop(Next, Parent, Announced);
 1536:         Message ->
 1537:             {Next, Events} = quod_agent_observer:handle(Message, S),
 1538:             lists:foreach(fun(E) -> send_observation(E, Parent) end, Events),
 1539:             case Message of
 1540:                 {_, {peer_loss, _, Key, _, Kind, _}} ->
 1541:                     Parent ! {observer_loss_handled, self(), Key, Kind,
 1542:                               map_size(maps:get(requests, Next))};
 1543:                 _ -> ok
 1544:             end,
 1545:             Peers = maps:values(maps:get(hosts, Next)),
 1546:             Ready = lists:all(fun(P) -> maps:get(pending, P) =:= none andalso
 1547:                 (maps:get(delivered, P) =/= none orelse maps:get(contact, P) =:= unknown)
 1548:             end, Peers),
 1549:             case Ready andalso not Announced of
 1550:                 true -> Parent ! {observer_baseline, self(),
 1551:                     lists:all(fun(#{delivered := {_, reachable, _}}) -> true;
 1552:                                  (_) -> false end, Peers), length(Peers)};
 1553:                 false -> ok
 1554:             end,
 1555:             observer_test_loop(Next, Parent, Announced orelse Ready)
 1556:     end.
 1557: 
 1558: send_observation({observed_host, Batch}, Parent) ->
 1559:     case quod_agent_observer:next(Batch) of
 1560:         done -> ok;
 1561:         {Event, Rest} ->
 1562:             Parent ! {observer_event, self(), Event},
 1563:             send_observation({observed_host, Rest}, Parent)
 1564:     end.
 1565: 
 1566: flush_observer_snapshots(Owner) ->
 1567:     receive {observer_loss_handled, Owner, _, _, _} -> flush_observer_snapshots(Owner)
 1568:     after 0 -> ok end.
 1569: 
 1570: install_loss_contact(Key, Endpoint, Sequence) ->
 1571:     Ns = <<"loss-test:", (binary:encode_hex(Key))/binary>>,
 1572:     Anchor = crypto:hash(sha256, Ns),
 1573:     Ref = {agent_instance_ref, Ns, Anchor, physical_node},
 1574:     {ok, Blob} = quod_wire_term:encode_canonical(Ref),
 1575:     {ok, _} = quod_directory:install_generation(
 1576:       #{author => {node_actor, Blob}, node_key => Key, endpoint => Endpoint,
 1577:         epoch => 1, generation => Sequence, page => 0, last => true,
 1578:         hosted => [{Ns, Anchor, observer, node}]}),
 1579:     Ref.
 1580: 
 1581: loss_snapshot(Authority, Ref, Key) ->
 1582:     receive
 1583:         {Ref, {peer_loss, Authority, Key, Episode, Status, _}} -> {Episode, Status}
 1584:     after 5000 -> ct:fail(no_loss_snapshot)
 1585:     end.
 1586: 
 1587: await_loss(Authority, Key, Episode, Status) ->
 1588:     receive
 1589:         {peer_loss, Authority, Key, Episode, Status, ObservedAt} when is_integer(ObservedAt) -> ok;
 1590:         {peer_loss, Authority, Key, Episode, Other, _} -> ct:fail({unexpected_loss_status, Other})
 1591:     after 8000 -> ct:fail(no_loss_notice)
 1592:     end.
 1593: 
 1594: await_no_connections(Authority, Key, Before) ->
 1595:     receive
 1596:         {peer_connections, Authority, Revision, Key, []} when Revision > Before -> ok;
 1597:         {peer_connections, Authority, Revision, Key, _} when Revision > Before ->
 1598:             await_no_connections(Authority, Key, Revision)
 1599:     after 5000 -> ct:fail(connections_not_removed)
 1600:     end.
 1601: 
 1602: confirmation(Authority, Ref, Key) ->
 1603:     receive
 1604:         {peer_confirmation, Authority, Ref, Key, Conn, Result, _ObservationTime} -> {Conn, Result}
 1605:     after 5000 -> ct:fail(no_peer_confirmation)
 1606:     end.
 1607: 
 1608: peer_snapshot(Authority, Key) ->
 1609:     Ref = quod_quic:peer_connections(Authority, Key),
 1610:     receive
 1611:         {Ref, {peer_connections, Authority, Revision, Key, Connections}} ->
 1612:             {Revision, Connections}
 1613:     after 5000 -> ct:fail(no_peer_snapshot)
 1614:     end.
 1615: 
 1616: await_connection_removed(Authority, Key, Conn, Previous) ->
 1617:     receive
 1618:         {peer_connections, Authority, Revision, Key, Connections}
 1619:           when Revision > Previous ->
 1620:             case lists:member(Conn, Connections) of
 1621:                 false -> Revision;
 1622:                 true -> await_connection_removed(Authority, Key, Conn, Revision)
 1623:             end
 1624:     after 5000 -> ct:fail(no_connection_withdrawal)
 1625:     end.
 1626: 
 1627: %% A successful pinned directory link must suppress the receiver's normal
 1628: %% header-driven Pubkey=>Addr learning. Preloading a divergent value makes the
 1629: %% assertion non-vacuous: an ordinary header would overwrite it with ?SELF.
 1630: pinned_dial_suppresses_hint_learning(Config) ->
 1631:     Pub = ?config(self_pubkey, Config),
 1632:     Existing = {"127.0.0.1", 14444},
 1633:     ok = quod_quic:learn(Pub, Existing),
 1634:     Ref = quod_quic:open_link_pinned(
 1635:             Pub, ?SELF, <<"chan-pinned-no-learn">>),
 1636:     receive
 1637:         {link_up, Ref, Pub, <<"chan-pinned-no-learn">>, LinkPid}
 1638:           when is_pid(LinkPid) -> ok
 1639:     after 5000 -> ct:fail(no_pinned_link_up)
 1640:     end,
 1641:     {ok, Existing} = quod_quic:resolve(Pub).
 1642: 
 1643: %% no_learn belongs to the isolated connection, not merely its first stream.
 1644: %% Force its accepted side to open a reverse stream: if the policy were not
 1645: %% inherited, that header would overwrite the deliberately divergent cache value.
 1646: pinned_reverse_stream_suppresses_hint_learning(Config) ->
 1647:     Pub = ?config(self_pubkey, Config),
 1648:     Forward = <<"chan-pinned-forward">>,
 1649:     Reverse = <<"chan-pinned-reverse">>,
 1650:     Existing = {"127.0.0.1", 14447},
 1651:     true = quod_reg:subscribe({channel, Forward}),
 1652:     Ref = quod_quic:open_link_pinned(Pub, ?SELF, Forward),
 1653:     OutLink = receive
 1654:                   {link_up, Ref, Pub, Forward, L} -> L
 1655:               after 5000 -> ct:fail(no_pinned_forward_link)
 1656:               end,
 1657:     ok = quod_link:send(OutLink, <<"find-inbound-connection">>),
 1658:     InLink = receive
 1659:                  {quod_message, {_, In}, Forward, <<"find-inbound-connection">>} -> In
 1660:              after 5000 -> ct:fail(no_pinned_forward_message)
 1661:              end,
 1662:     {links, [InboundConn]} = process_info(InLink, links),
 1663:     %% Publication happens only after the connection owner has authenticated
 1664:     %% the header and latched no_learn.
 1665:     ok = quod_quic:learn(Pub, Existing),
 1666:     ok = quod_conn:open_link(InboundConn, Reverse, self()),
 1667:     receive
 1668:         {link_up, _, Reverse, ReverseLink} when is_pid(ReverseLink) -> ok
 1669:     after 5000 -> ct:fail(no_pinned_reverse_link)
 1670:     end,
 1671:     {ok, Existing} = quod_quic:resolve(Pub).
 1672: 
 1673: %% Identity discovery derives the actual certificate key but leaves promotion
 1674: %% to its caller; its no-learn header must not touch the shared address cache.
 1675: identified_dial_suppresses_hint_learning(Config) ->
 1676:     Pub = ?config(self_pubkey, Config),
 1677:     Existing = {"127.0.0.1", 14445},
 1678:     ok = quod_quic:learn(Pub, Existing),
 1679:     Channel = <<"chan-identified-no-learn">>,
 1680:     Ref = quod_quic:open_link_identified(?SELF, Channel),
 1681:     receive
 1682:         {link_up, Ref, Pub, Channel, LinkPid}
 1683:           when is_pid(LinkPid) -> ok
 1684:     after 5000 -> ct:fail(no_identified_link_up)
 1685:     end,
 1686:     {ok, Existing} = quod_quic:resolve(Pub).
 1687: 
 1688: %% The new directory policy is scoped: existing endpoint/cache links keep
 1689: %% learning the authenticated header address exactly as before.
 1690: ordinary_dial_still_learns_hint(Config) ->
 1691:     Pub = ?config(self_pubkey, Config),
 1692:     Existing = {"127.0.0.1", 14446},
 1693:     ok = quod_quic:learn(Pub, Existing),
 1694:     ok = quod_quic:open_link(?SELF, <<"chan-ordinary-learn">>),
 1695:     receive
 1696:         {link_up, ?SELF, <<"chan-ordinary-learn">>, LinkPid} when is_pid(LinkPid) -> ok
 1697:     after 5000 -> ct:fail(no_ordinary_link_up)
 1698:     end,
 1699:     {ok, ?SELF} = quod_quic:resolve(Pub).
 1700: 
 1701: %% Dialing the right endpoint is insufficient: a different valid Ed25519
 1702: %% certificate must fail before any stream becomes usable.
 1703: pinned_dial_rejects_wrong_cert(Config) ->
 1704:     Expected = ?config(self_pubkey, Config),
 1705:     {_WrongPub, _} = WrongKP = quod_identity:generate(),
 1706:     WrongCert = quod_identity:mint_cert(WrongKP),
 1707:     WrongKey = quod_identity:key_term(WrongKP),
 1708:     Handler = fun(_Conn) ->
 1709:                   {ok, spawn(fun Ignore() -> receive _ -> Ignore() end end)}
 1710:               end,
 1711:     Port = 14596,
 1712:     Endpoint = {"127.0.0.1", Port},
 1713:     {ok, _} = quic:start_server(pinned_wrong_cert, Port,
 1714:                                 #{cert => WrongCert, key => WrongKey, verify => true,
 1715:                                   alpn => [<<"quod">>], connection_handler => Handler}),
 1716:     try
 1717:         Ref = quod_quic:open_link_pinned(
 1718:                 Expected, Endpoint, <<"chan-pinned-wrong-cert">>),
 1719:         receive
 1720:             {link_error, Ref, Expected, <<"chan-pinned-wrong-cert">>} -> ok;
 1721:             {link_up, Ref, Expected, <<"chan-pinned-wrong-cert">>, _} ->
 1722:                 ct:fail(pinned_dial_accepted_wrong_cert)
 1723:         after 5000 -> ct:fail(no_pinned_mismatch_result)
 1724:         end
 1725:     after
 1726:         _ = quic:stop_server(pinned_wrong_cert)
 1727:     end.
 1728: 
 1729: %% A view id that is not a dialable {Host, Port} must be refused with link_error,
 1730: %% NOT crash the transport authority (it would take down every connection).
 1731: non_dialable_node_id(_Config) ->
 1732:     Authority = quod_reg:where({transport, node}),
 1733:     true = is_pid(Authority),
 1734:     ok = quod_quic:open_link(<<"not-a-host-port">>, <<"chan-x">>),
 1735:     receive
 1736:         {link_error, <<"not-a-host-port">>, <<"chan-x">>} -> ok
 1737:     after 3000 -> ct:fail(no_link_error)
 1738:     end,
 1739:     %% same pid still registered => the authority survived (did not crash/restart)
 1740:     Authority = quod_reg:where({transport, node}),
 1741:     true = is_process_alive(Authority).
